role_policy.main_plane: the sixteen official plane runs planes/<T>/<A>/<z1|z2>
role_policy.main_combined: the eight official dual-height layouts combined/<T>/<A> (only these enter the 8-group comparison figures)
role_policy.sensitivity: Phase-11 matrix; own process block (radius/gap vary), never assumed to be R=40
role_policy.c_sweep: C-design ablation documentation only; NOT part of the eight official combined layouts

bend_loss.note: no femtosecond-laser-written glass bend-loss function is known; R=40 mm is a geometry constraint only, not a measured loss value

crossing_loss.note: single-layer crossing optical feasibility not confirmed; crossing count is a geometric metric only

loss_policy.legacy_polymer_model: NOT used as glass truth; omission flagged

notes: every number comes from the per-run statistics.json recomputed from primitives by four_side_1024.fslw.metrics; missing runs are marked, never guessed
z1 (row 1, 512 opposite) and z2 (row 2, 512 adjacent) are independent 2D problems at two model heights; cross-plane XY projections are informational only and never violations (SPEC §2)
bend loss and crossing loss are unknown_uncalibrated; only the propagation arm (0.05 dB/cm) is a computed loss number
